scope: Inspected single-device shared macOS development controls, one numerical thread; no qualified timing, process RSS, prospective, SDK ranking or scalability claim
driver:
"""Inspect fixed-gate matrix deferral against the exact integrated implementation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import contextlib
import cProfile
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import pstats
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tracemalloc
from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path.cwd()
HARNESS = Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121')
BASE = '11745ab11070765974b90f5a8f512bf4c30576b1'
SOURCE_PATH = 'flagquantum/compiler/optimization/one_qubit_optimization.py'
OUTPUT = Path('/private/tmp/fq-lazy-single-qubit-controls-20261122.json')

def git(folder: Path, *arguments: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *arguments], cwd=folder, text=True, timeout=15).strip()

assert git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == '9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
assert not git(HARNESS, 'status', '--porcelain')
sys.path.insert(0, str(HARNESS / 'src'))
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import one_qubit_optimization as one_qubit
from flagquantum.compiler import optimize
from flagquantum.core.ir import CircuitIR, Instruction
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter, workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing

candidate = one_qubit.collapse_one_qubit_runs
baseline_source = git(ROOT, 'show', BASE + ':' + SOURCE_PATH)
node = next(item for item in ast.parse(baseline_source).body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == candidate.__name__)
namespace = dict(vars(one_qubit))
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), BASE + ':' + SOURCE_PATH, 'exec'), namespace)
baseline = namespace[candidate.__name__]

@contextlib.contextmanager
def variant(name: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        if name == 'baseline':
            for module_name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
                if module_name.startswith('flagquantum.') and module is not None:
                    for key, value in tuple(vars(module).items()):
                        if value is candidate:
                            stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, key, baseline))
        yield

def observe(case: tuple[int, str, str], workflow: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    width, family, topology = case
    bundle = Bundle(HARNESS / 'docs/implementation')
    acceptance = bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width == 8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
    config = workflow_configuration(workflow)
    adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options': {'sdk': config['sdk'], 'workflow': workflow, 'compiler_options': config}}))
    source = fixture(width, family, topology, '01' * 32)
    seed = bundle.plan['execution_profile']['compiler_seeds'][0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    payload = adapter.execute('route', source, seed)
    seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
    metrics = routing(payload, source, None, acceptance, 0)
    assert payload['final_layout'] == list(range(width))
    normalized = json.dumps({key: payload[key] for key in ('operations', 'final_layout')}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
    return {'metrics': metrics, 'normalized_output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest(), 'audit': dict(adapter.audit), 'seconds': seconds}

report: dict[str, Any] = {'implementation_commit': git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'base_commit': BASE, 'source_commit': git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'scope': 'Inspected single-device shared macOS development controls, one numerical thread; no qualified timing, process RSS, prospective, SDK ranking or scalability claim', 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / SOURCE_PATH).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'baseline_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(baseline_source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'driver': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'complete': False, 'rows': [], 'timing': [], 'memory': [], 'profiles': []}

def checkpoint() -> None:
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')

for workflow in ('flagquantum-ordinary-restored', 'flagquantum-target-artifact'):
    for index, case in enumerate(itertools.product((6, 8, 12), ('qaoa', 'ising', 'hopping', 'qft', 'repetition'), ('line', 'ring', 'grid', 'sparse'))):
        observations = {}
        for mode in (('baseline', 'candidate') if index % 2 == 0 else ('candidate', 'baseline')):
            with variant(mode):
                observations[mode] = observe(case, workflow)
        assert all(observations['baseline'][key] == observations['candidate'][key] for key in ('metrics', 'normalized_output_sha256', 'audit')), (workflow, case, observations)
        report['rows'].append({'workflow': workflow, 'case': case, 'observations': observations})
        checkpoint()
    print('Accepted all 60 paired workflows:', workflow, flush=True)

programs = {f'independent-h-{width}': CircuitIR(width, tuple(Instruction('h', (wire,)) for wire in range(width))) for width in (4000, 32000)}
programs['mixed-local-4'] = CircuitIR(4, tuple(item for _ in range(8) for item in (Instruction('h', (0,)), Instruction('rz', (0,), {'theta': 0.31}), Instruction('cx', (0, 1)), Instruction('h', (2,)), Instruction('rx', (3,), {'theta': -0.42}))))
for name, program in programs.items():
    samples: dict[str, list[float]] = {'baseline': [], 'candidate': []}
    for iteration in range(11):
        for mode in (('baseline', 'candidate') if iteration % 2 == 0 else ('candidate', 'baseline')):
            with variant(mode):
                start = time.perf_counter(); result = optimize(program); elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
            if name.startswith('independent'):
                assert result.instructions == program.instructions
            if iteration >= 2:
                samples[mode].append(elapsed)
    report['timing'].append({'case': name, 'samples_seconds': samples, 'median_seconds': {mode: statistics.median(values) for mode, values in samples.items()}})
    for mode in ('baseline', 'candidate'):
        with variant(mode):
            tracemalloc.start(); optimize(program); peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[1]; tracemalloc.stop()
        report['memory'].append({'case': name, 'mode': mode, 'python_peak_bytes': peak})
        profiler = cProfile.Profile()
        with variant(mode):
            profiler.enable(); optimize(program); profiler.disable()
        functions = [{'name': name, 'calls': total, 'self_seconds': own, 'cumulative_seconds': cumulative} for (file, line, name), (primitive, total, own, cumulative, callers) in pstats.Stats(profiler).stats.items() if 'one_qubit_optimization.py' in file]
        report['profiles'].append({'case': name, 'mode': mode, 'functions': functions})
    checkpoint(); print(name, report['timing'][-1]['median_seconds'], flush=True)
report['complete'] = True
checkpoint()
